title.label: It drains the battery fast, and the phone gets boiling hot.

content.label:
Ever since the last couple of updates, I've run into a major issue: my iPhone gets extremely hot. 

Whenever I close Typeless, the problem stops. I tried uninstalling it and downloading the new version, but the issue is still there. 

I really hope the developers can fix this soon. My battery gets so hot it honestly feels like it's going to explode.
